purpose: Long UTF-8 paragraph: many accented letters, em/en dashes, curly and angle quotes, currency signs; wraps over several lines.
notes: Measures Unicode glyph coverage/advance widths and line breaking with non-ASCII words; pdflatex needs T1/utf8 — characters outside T1 (e.g. ǅ, ¥ in some encodings) may be reported as missing by the oracle log.
page_size: US letter 612x792pt (geometry default paper for article is letterpaper)
preamble_policy: engine-specific apples-to-apples preamble is substituted by the harness; FlashTeX gets the body only
